p2PlayWAV.summary: Streams a supported PCM WAV file through an explicitly selected DAC pin/cog, waits for queued samples to finish and closes the file.
p2PlayWAV.returns: True on successful completion, false on header, queue, initialization or drain failure.
prerequisites: Import P2 Audio and its declared dependencies.
inputs: 1. P2 play WAV file: text; library example sound.wav.

examples.title: Use P2 play WAV file … DAC pin … cog …
examples.code: P2 play WAV file [sound.wav] DAC pin [16] cog [3]
examples.explanation: Block notation: Streams a supported PCM WAV file through an explicitly selected DAC pin/cog, waits for queued samples to finish and closes the file. True on successful completion, false on header, queue, initialization or drain failure.

notes: Candidate extension-9 firmware required; not in the reviewed revision-8 installer. DAC PCM WAV: 8/16-bit mono/stereo, 8000-22050 Hz, explicit user pin and free cog. VM remains interactive. Queue underruns/timing are reported; audible output and cadence untested. Use a suitable AC-coupled amplifier input, never drive a speaker from a GPIO.
Source: boards\propeller2\integration\libraries\P2 Audio.ubl. Examples are illustrative block notation, not hardware acceptance tests.
